title: SEMP In Artificial Intelligence In Finance
description: A course designed to integrate artificial intelligence with finance for advanced strategic and analytical solutions.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: This SEMP in Artificial Intelligence in Finance equips learners with cutting-edge skills to navigate the evolving financial landscape. It covers strategic risk management, people analytics, big data, and enterprise blockchain with a focus on trade finance. The course explores artificial intelligence applications to optimize decision-making and enhance financial strategies. Learners gain a deep understanding of risk analysis and modelling in a global financial context. The program prepares participants to apply emerging technologies for improved efficiency, compliance, and innovation in financial operations. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The programme effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: The curriculum combines advanced AI techniques with strategic risk management to address financial challenges. People analytics and big data modules focus on extracting insights to support business decisions. Enterprise blockchain and trade finance enhance understanding of secure and transparent transactions. Global finance and strategy provide a comprehensive view of international financial dynamics and risk modelling techniques. This programme delivers in-depth expertise in artificial intelligence applications within finance and strategic risk management. It enables the use of advanced technologies to transform financial processes and global trade practices. Course Details: Strategic Risk Management – Focuses on identifying, assessing, and mitigating financial risks through strategic approaches. Artificial Intelligence – Explores AI applications to enhance decision-making and operational efficiency in finance. People Analytics and Big Data – Examines the use of analytics and big data to drive informed financial strategies. Enterprise Blockchain and Trade Finance – Covers blockchain integration to improve transparency and security in trade finance. Global Finance and Strategy – Analyzes international financial systems and their influence on strategic planning. Risk Analysis and Modelling – Develops skills to model, forecast, and manage complex financial risks. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project (GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in Artificial Intelligence in Finance and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 5 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.
